editorial:
You get pulled into a marriage that feels warm at first, then slowly turns into a nightmare. You meet a couple who share everything, from jokes to habits to secrets, and that closeness becomes the scary part. The movie keeps you guessing about who is changing whom, and every quiet dinner or late-night talk feels like it could go wrong. If you like horror that gets under your skin instead of just throwing gore at you, this one has a strong, creepy pull.

The acting is the big win here, especially the way both leads make small moments feel tense. The pacing is steady, though some scenes in the middle may feel a little slow if you want nonstop scares. The ending lands hard and gives you plenty to talk about after. Watch it if you enjoy relationship horror and dark twists. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn the husband has been copying his wife so completely that he starts taking over her identity. The wife tries to break free, but the last twist shows she has also been copying him, and their faces blur together in the mirror. The movie ends with one of them walking out as the other, leaving you unsure who survived and who got trapped.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves relationship horror and dark twists.
